name: Akatsuki
description: JAXA's Venus Climate Orbiter, the only active spacecraft at Venus. Originally failed orbit insertion in 2010 but was recovered on a backup attempt five years later (2015) using less efficient thrusters. Studies cloud-top winds, lightning, and atmospheric dynamics of Venus's super-rotating atmosphere.
best_known_for: Only active Venus orbiter; cloud-top winds and atmosphere dynamics. Recovered after a 2010 orbit-insertion failure
